gameplan.summary: Scale safely to 3 items then hypercarry teamfights with Fishbones AoE. Never get caught alone.
gameplan.win_condition: Stay safe in teamfights behind your frontline. Let Fishbones shred grouped enemies.
gameplan.early_game: Farm safely with Minigun. Only poke with Fishbones when mana allows. Play for 3 items.
gameplan.positioning: Extreme backline. Never walk up without peel. Use E traps to create distance from divers.

caitlyn.tips: She outranges you early. Farm under tower. Buy Vampiric Scepter to sustain her poke.
caitlyn.power_shift: You outscale at 3 items. Survive laning phase and win late teamfights.

draven.tips: He wins all early trades. Play for farm only. Don't fight without support CC to set up.
draven.power_shift: Equal at 2 items. You win if game goes long — his lead fades without kills.

jhin.tips: Dodge his W root — it enables his full combo. Farm and scale. Buy early Vampiric Scepter.
jhin.power_shift: You outscale in teamfights. His damage spikes before yours.

ezreal.tips: He pokes you but won't all-in. Farm freely. He can't engage without Arcane Shift.
ezreal.power_shift: You win sustained teamfights at 3 items. He falls off unless snowballed.

zeri.tips: She kites better than you. Play around your support CC. Don't chase her.
zeri.power_shift: Even at 3 items. Win through superior AoE in 5v5 teamfights.
